3085.note_text: In the case of type evaluation, an Issuing Authority may be a national Type Approval Body and/or, for the implementation of the OIML Mutual Acceptance Arrangement (MAA), an OIML Issuing Authority according to 2.13 of OIML B 3 and 3.11 of B 10-1.

3083.note_text: any Authority that is responsible for issuing Certificates within a specified system of legal metrology control
